parameters.name: ActionType
parameters.description:
The action to take on requests that trigger the control. Valid values:

- **observe**: Monitors the requests.

- **deny**: Blocks the requests.

- **js**: Issues a JS challenge.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable automatic frequency control. Valid values:

- **on**: Enables automatic frequency control.

- **off**: Disables automatic frequency control.

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description:
The protection level. Valid values:

- **loose**: Loose protection.

- **normal**: Normal protection.

- **strict**: Strict protection.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The ID of the site. Call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain this ID.

parameters.name: SiteVersion
parameters.description: The version of the site. For a site with version management enabled, this parameter specifies the version to which the configuration applies. The default value is 0.
